Description of Additional Supplementary Files 
 
 
File name: Supplementary Data 1 
Description: Characterization of alanine/valine mutants of the CB2R including expression 
levels, Emax, and pEC50 for Gαi2 and βarr1 and classified coupling profile. 
 
File name: Supplementary Data 2 
Description: Contact frequencies of each simulated mutant per replicate. 
 
File name: Supplementary Data 3 
Description: Transmission information computed as degeneracy for 35 simulated mutants. 
  
File name: Supplementary Data 4 
Description: BRET response scores of the simulated mutants.
